contest.title: {boss}: {mode}
contest.desc: {desc} Beat this record to play as {boss}.
contest.descMore: {desc} {boss} already runs with you. Beat this record too, and see what happens.
contest.locked: {boss} takes challenges here once every mission of this level is complete.
contest.briefing.reward: Beat me, and you can play as me.
contest.briefing.more: You already run as me. Win here too, and you will see something new.
contest.briefing.workshop: My look is still in the workshop, but the record is real. Beat it now and I open for you the day I'm ready.
contest.verdict.draw: Exactly the same time. It takes a faster one.
contest.upgraded: {boss} levels up: now with the {fx} effect!
contest.unlockedLater: Victory counted! This character is still in the workshop and opens for you as soon as it is ready.
contest.outfits: {n, plural, one {# look} other {# looks}}, a random one every run
contest.lockedCharacter: Beat a record on {level}: Flag hunt or Sprint
boss.shahzada.name: Shahzada
boss.shahzada.desc: The forefather of parkour in games: he ran along palace walls before it was cool. When things go wrong he turns back time, then swears it never happened.
boss.shahzada.briefing.flags: Five flags, any order, {time}. And if you fall: no, no, that is not how it happened. Again.
boss.shahzada.briefing.sprint: Flags in order, then the goal. I'll be there after {time}, sand in my sandals and not a scratch.
boss.shahzada.won: Hm. In my version of the story I won. That's how I'll tell it.
boss.shahzada.lost: No, no, no. That's not how it happened. Shall we start over?
boss.rewind.name: Rewind
boss.rewind.desc: A photographer from a quiet town by a lighthouse. She hates being the centre of attention, so she turns back time until nobody notices her winning.
boss.rewind.briefing.flags: Five flags in {time}. Wait… I've seen this before. Oh right: you lose.
boss.rewind.briefing.sprint: In order, then the goal, {time}. I'll take a picture of you finishing. Eventually.
boss.rewind.won: Okay, that was… actually amazing. And I can't even rewind it.
boss.rewind.lost: Don't worry, I won't post this one. Probably.
boss.grove.name: Grove
boss.grove.desc: Came home for a funeral and hasn't had a quiet day since. Knows every rooftop of his street and every way to lose a chase.
boss.grove.briefing.flags: Ah, here we go again. Five flags, {time}. Respect is earned, homie.
boss.grove.briefing.sprint: All you have to do is follow the flags. In order. In {time}. Don't miss the train.
boss.grove.won: Respect +. You're one of us now.
boss.grove.lost: All you had to do was follow the flags!
boss.vera.name: Vera
boss.vera.desc: A courier of the mirrored city: she delivers anything anywhere without touching the ground. The red shoes are so you can see who passed you.
boss.vera.briefing.flags: Five drops, any order, {time}. Follow the red… no wait, the red is mine.
boss.vera.briefing.sprint: Route's marked, flags in order, {time}. Don't look down.
boss.vera.won: Clean run. The city needs runners like you.
boss.b2.name: B-2
boss.b2.desc: An android in a blindfold: runs in silence, in heels, with a sword on her back, and suspects everyone. Glory to… well, somebody.
boss.b2.briefing.sprint: Route confirmed. Goal in {time}. I will wait. Androids are patient.
boss.b2.won: …Recalculating. Everything that lives is made to end. My record too.
boss.b2.lost: Mission complete. Yours, not so much.
boss.sir-nobody.name: Sir Nobody
boss.sir-nobody.desc: Mysterious, but always ready to help. Never takes off the helmet, not even at the goal. Who's inside? Nobody knows. Not even him.
boss.sir-nobody.briefing.flags: Need help? Ah, a race. Then help yourself: five flags, {time}.
boss.sir-nobody.briefing.sprint: Upon my oath: the goal in {time}. The armour rattles, the record doesn't.
boss.sir-nobody.won: Well run! Should you ever need a hand, I'll be on some roof.
boss.sir-nobody.lost: Don't despair. May I help you up?
boss.granger.name: Granger
boss.granger.desc: Jumps back and forth through time, and every day brings the same news from the future.
boss.granger.briefing.flags: Five flags, {time}. By the way: they're showing Bloodborne for PC today, check it.
boss.granger.briefing.sprint: Flags in order, goal in {time}. Blink and you'll miss me.
boss.granger.won: Okay, you got me. I'll rewind and pretend it was the plan.
boss.granger.lost: Too slow! Even Bloodborne for PC gets announced faster.
boss.rush-b.name: Rush B
boss.rush-b.desc: Two squads, one team: terrorists or special forces, whoever the round hands out. Knows one tactic, and it's in the name.
boss.rush-b.briefing.flags: Five flags, {time}. No camping. Go, go, go!
boss.rush-b.briefing.sprint: The flags have been planted… in order. Goal in {time}.
boss.five.name: Five
boss.five.desc: A mercenary of the night city with a stranger's voice in the head and a jacket that glows. The future is here, and it's late for your record.
boss.five.briefing.flags: Five flags, {time}. The voice in my head says you won't make it.
boss.five.briefing.sprint: Flags in order, goal in {time}. Preem route, choom.
boss.five.won: Nova. No implants, and that fast?
boss.five.lost: Flatlined. Want a reflex booster? I know a guy.
boss.flittermouse.name: Flittermouse
boss.flittermouse.desc: A billionaire by day; by night a man in a cape whom other people's records keep awake. Don't ask about his parents.
boss.flittermouse.briefing.flags: Five flags. {time}. I am the dusk. And the record.
boss.flittermouse.briefing.sprint: Flags in order, goal in {time}. When you get there, I'll be gone. Then I'll be back.
boss.flittermouse.lost: Criminals are superstitious and cowardly. You were just slow.
boss.pierre.name: Pierre Radieux
boss.pierre.desc: A master of disguise: a swordsman today, a mechanic tomorrow, anyone at all the day after. They say he has a twin sister; they say no one has ever seen them together. They also say this remake is the work of one of them.
boss.pierre.briefing.flags: Five flags, {time}. On guard! And try to recognise me at the finish.
boss.pierre.briefing.sprint: En garde! Flags in order, the goal in {time}. Touché comes later.
boss.pierre.won: Touché. Just don't tell my sister.
boss.pierre.lost: Parry, riposte, finish. Next time watch the blade, not the costume.
boss.azure.name: Azure
boss.azure.desc: An archaeologist only a hundred and six years old: by her people's measure, barely a student. She studies vanished civilisations and, in her spare time, deals in other people's secrets. Your record is already in her catalogue of antiquities.
boss.azure.briefing.flags: Five flags in {time}. I have studied this island down to the last stone. Try to surprise me.
boss.azure.briefing.sprint: Flags in order, the goal in {time}. I'll, um... be there. Before you. Sorry.
boss.azure.won: Fascinating! May I... study you? For science, of course.
boss.azure.lost: Don't be upset: in a hundred years I have seen many fast ones. You will make it into my archive too.
